name: Notion Pilot
tagline: Your CRM lives in Notion. The agent keeps it current.
cta: Deploy the CRM in your own Notion
notes: Monochrome instrument: white stock, achromatic grey ramp, near-black as the only brand colour.
Colour appears ONLY inside CRM data — won / stale / lost. Never decoration.
Same design system as web/frontend/src/styles/tokens.css. Do not invent new hues.
No audio: these render as muted autoplay loops on the landing page.
